objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short type-based abbreviation code assigned to the document (e.g., RL_0001).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The sequential version identifier of the document, updated on each new release.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date until which the document version remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope or area of validity of the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language in which the document content is maintained or translated.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The configurable period for validity checks, default 3 years per document type.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original Office format of the document content (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document via its properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas associated with the document's validity.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version identifier of the attachment, tracked independently.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The lifecycle status of the attachment, following the main document's release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for change to an existing released document, managed in the document's cockpit and tracked through to implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to extend or revise the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggered when the document has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated (archived) document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system/license role assigned to the user (e.g., Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign authorizations and distribution, such as Reader group, Author group, Reviewer group, Releaser group, Archive group.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A configurable classification category for documents in the system, defining levels and associated templates and settings.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the document type in the document pyramid (e.g., Level 2, Level 4).

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: The standard abbreviation code for the document type.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The list of user groups and persons assigned to receive a document via email notification or for acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that manages tasks through steps such as Creator, Review, and Release with electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity (department, location, etc.) that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific filing.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents via the database integration.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document (information object) is created in the system by attaching a new object with selection of document type and template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness in the review workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the process for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when revisions or changes are made.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled sub-document) is created and linked to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment's content is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document, not subject to the release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document directly due to its lack of criticality.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of a change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (or author/reviewer/releaser) confirms the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates an override (invalidation) request for a document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request to reactivate an archived document is created by the Business Admin group.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to confirm acknowledgement of a released document version.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read and write permissions are assigned to user groups and persons for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language for language-dependent display.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is reviewed and released with workflow support.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, archived documents are physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: A document can have one or more controlled attachments linked to it.
A document can have one or more additional information objects supplementing it.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to initiate invalidation.
A request for reactivation references the archived document to be reactivated.
Documents can reference other documents via the References attribute.
A document is created based on one of the defined templates for its document type.
Each document is classified under a specific document type.
A document has a distribution list specifying user groups and persons for notification.
Documents can be linked to processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to organizational units.
Documents can be linked to risks via database integration.
In a multi-client system, each document can be set visible or hidden per client.
A distribution list contains assigned user groups.
A distribution list contains directly assigned individual persons.
User groups contain individual users who inherit group-level authorizations.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
